# Rotaract Club Invoice Calculator (RSAMDIO)
> Free planning estimate for Rotaract club invoices based on a January 1 membership snapshot. Built by Rotaract South Asia MDIO.

## Pages
- Home: https://dues.rsamdio.org/
- FAQ: https://dues.rsamdio.org/faq.html
- How RI dues work (this estimate): https://dues.rsamdio.org/how-ri-dues-work.html
- Privacy: https://dues.rsamdio.org/privacy.html
- Terms: https://dues.rsamdio.org/terms.html
- Organization: https://rsamdio.org/

## Rates used in this estimate (USD per member per year)
- Community-Based clubs: $8
- University-Based clubs: $5

## Billing model (this calculator)
- Invoice date: 1 January of the selected invoice year
- Members active on 1 January: full-year annual dues for that invoice year
- Join after 1 January of the invoice year: $0 on this invoice; prorated catch-up appears on the next January invoice
- Prior-year mid-year joiners: next January includes full year plus prorated catch-up for months in the prior year — formula (Annual ÷ 12) × months

## Disclaimer
This tool produces indicative planning estimates only. It is not an official Rotary International Club Invoice. Verify membership and amounts in My Rotary and with official RI sources before payment.
Official Club Invoice FAQ: https://my.rotary.org/en/club-invoice-faq
